resolutions.title: The cut ledger cannot reliably identify the bytes it must restore
resolutions.evidence: Design D5's and the ADDED requirement's `moved` row recorded only 'the moved text's first line' and checked the reference against itself; M5 inserts into an existing reference, and M10 and the chain paragraph move text the reference already holds.
